'''Torgau''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guard who worked for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] he was one of the guard's at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Torgau was one of thirteen Gamorrean [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player characters]] that could be found in Jabba's palace in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. His existence contradicted several other [[canon]] sources that claim only nine Gamorreans worked in the palace. This was further contradicted by the fact that [[Jubnuk/Legends|Jubnuk]], [[Thug/Legends|Thug]], [[Thok (Gamorrean guard)/Legends|Thok]], [[Warlug]], [[Ghana Gleemort/Legends|Ghana Gleemort]], and [[Grissom (Gamorrean)|Grissom]] were not in the game, suggesting that a total of nineteen Gamorrean guards worked in Jabba's palace.
